from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class AssetDisclosure(BaseModel):
    """A single asset line item reported in one company's filing for the period in question."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company the filing belongs to")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label as it appears in the balance sheet")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The dollar amount reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Whether amount is in 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions', etc.")
    period_date: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period date for this figure")
    is_current_asset: bool | None = Field(description="Whether the line item is under Current Assets section")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the filing")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    asset_disclosures: list[AssetDisclosure]
